description: Notify on every completed scenario analysis run. Disabled by default to avoid noise; enable for high-touch clients that want a completion heartbeat.
Notify when any domain agent Finding reaches or exceeds a high risk score, one message per qualifying Finding.
Notify when a Decision Queue item is flagged review_required, one message per qualifying Decision.
Notify when a non-baseline scenario delta records at least the configured number of combined evidence/score/decision changes.
Notify when a consolidated portfolio Decision is missing a required owner, one message per affected Decision group.
Notify when consolidated portfolio Decisions show potentially duplicate owner/deadline assignments across scenarios, one message per affected Decision group.
